azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.description: Inspect actual supported log categories and enabled native diagnostic destination declarations. Resource existence, authorization, ingestion and retention are separate assessments.
azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.fail_observation: Some supported AKS log categories lack an enabled native destination declaration. Log delivery was not tested.
azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.missing_observation: Complete native diagnostic configuration and source binding were unavailable or unsupported.
azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.pass_observation: AKS declares supported log categories with native diagnostic destination references. Destination access and log delivery were not tested.
azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.purpose: Read-only declared configuration; no inherited numbered compliance equivalence.
azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.remediation: Enable each supported control-plane log category with the intended diagnostic destination. Verify destination permissions and log delivery separately.
azure.logging.aks_supported_log_categori.title: AKS declares supported log categories to diagnostic destinations
